### Added

- Add an optional `backend` field in Settings › Agent List Fields that renders the Server backend (`core`, `tui`, `rex`, or `tmux`) separately from the Host name in Agent rows and Live Activities. (PR #758)
- Save a conversation title in Rename even while an Agent is running: Heeler confirms with an optional **Save and Don’t Show Again** choice, shows the new title on this device right away, and sends the native rename command automatically once the same Agent and conversation stop. (PR #752)
- Clear the prefilled title or name in Rename, Rename Agent, and Rename Workspace in one tap with the trailing clear button, keeping focus in the field. (PR #752)
- See which Hosts hold an older Heeler Plugin or Host Helper than the app carries without opening each Server's page. A card above the Hosts list counts the updates, the Hosts tab shows the count as a badge, each Host's row carries a tag, and Host detail lists the Host's Plugin and Helper versions. **Update All**, on the card and on the new Updates page, updates every Host's installed Plugin and Helper, Hosts side by side, and Updates opens once after an app update that brings newer versions. A first install still goes through its Server's page. An update that fails says whether nothing changed, whether the Host never answered (Heeler then reads it again), or whether the Helper needs **Repair**, and keeps **Try Again** with the Host's own words to copy and a link to the new [updates guide](https://docs.heeler.bybee.dev/updates) for updating on the Host by hand. (PR #751)
- Turn a Host's Codex Usage Limits on or off in Usage Limits, enabled by default (Host Helper 0.5.9). Turning Codex limits off hides Codex plan windows across Usage and widgets, omits turned-off Usage Limits entries from the Usage overview list and iPad strip, skips `codex app-server` rate-limit reads on updated Helpers and plugins, and keeps local Codex Token Usage counted. (PR #749)
- Show Antigravity CLI (`agy`) Token Usage, Usage Limits, and Accounts in Usage, widgets, and Settings › Agents & Accounts on macOS and Linux Hosts (plugin 0.10.0, Host Helper 0.5.8). Token Usage scans local `transcript_full.jsonl` files without network requests; Usage Limits ask the Host's `agy` CLI (`1.1.11` or newer) for its Gemini and Claude & GPT plan windows without reading credentials or Keychain items directly, and are enabled by default per Host with a toggle in Usage Limits to turn them off. Added Antigravity Accounts report their own Token Usage while keeping the Host's single sign-in Usage Limits on the Default Account. (PR #748)
- Show Antigravity CLI Subagents, Workflows, and non-daemon background commands in Chat's

detail.readme:
# Heeler **The iPhone and iPad console for the coding agents running on your own machines.** Works with [Herdr TUI](https://herdr.dev), the Herdr desktop app (herdr-core), and tmux. Rex support is experimental. [![GitHub stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/ZingerLittleBee/Heeler?style=flat-square&color=E8B923&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/ZingerLittleBee/Heeler/stargazers) [![CI](https://img.shields.io/github/actions/workflow/status/ZingerLittleBee/Heeler/ci.yml?branch=main&label=CI&style=flat-square)](https://github.com/ZingerLittleBee/Heeler/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![License: Apache 2.0](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-Apache_2.0-6F42C1?style=flat-square)](LICENSE) [![Swift](https://img.shields.io/badge/Swift-6-F05138?logo=swift&logoColor=white&style=flat-square)](https://www.swift.org) [![iOS](https://img.shields.io/badge/iOS-18%2B-000000?logo=apple&logoColor=white&style=flat-square)](https://developer.apple.com/ios/) [![App Store](https://img.shields.io/badge/App_Store-available-0D96F6?logo=apple&logoColor=white&style=flat-square)](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/id6797263135) English | [简体中文](./README-zh.md) | [繁體中文](./README-zh-TW.md) | [日本語](./README-ja.md)
--- Heeler is an independent, open-source agent console and **herdr mobile client** for Claude Code, Codex, and other coding Agents on iPhone and iPad. Agents keep running on your own machines in Herdr TUI, the Herdr desktop app (herdr-core), or tmux, and Heeler connects to them over SSH, so your code never passes through our servers. See which Agent needs you, answer in native Chat or the real terminal, and get an encrypted notification the moment one goes Blocked or Done. **[Website](https://heeler.bybee.dev)** · **[Documentation](https://docs.heeler.bybee.dev)** · [Privacy](PRIVACY.md) · [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md) ## Screenshots | Agent Console | Chat | Live terminal | | --- | --- | --- | | | | | | Live Activity | Usage | Widgets | | --- | --- | --- | | | | |
More screenshots | Keyboard | Changes | Terminals | | --- | --- | --- | | | | | | Skills | Hosts | Lock Screen widgets | | --- | --- | --- | | | | |
[View iPad screenshots](docs/ipad-screenshots.md) ## Features - **Console**: every Agent on every machine in one live list, sorted with Blocked first and filterable by Host. - **Chat**: an Agent's conversation as native messages, with buttons to answer a Blocked Agent. For Claude Code, Codex, Pi, Oh My Pi, Grok Build, OpenCode, and Antigravity CLI. [Chat guide](https://docs.heeler.bybee.dev/chat) - **Live terminal**: the Agent's real terminal, rendered by libghostty with native scrollback and selection, and a plain shell in the Agent's directory. - **Notifications and Live Activities**: an end-to-end encrypted push when an Agent goes Blocked or Done, and your Agents on the Lock Screen and Dynamic Island. The relay cannot read the content. [Privacy](PRIVACY.md) - **Usage**: Claude Code and Codex Usage Limits with their reset times, up to 30 days of Token Usage with its estimated API cost, and Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets. [Usage guide](https://docs.heeler.bybee.dev/usage) - **Composer**: draft with the full iOS keyboard or by voice, then Send once. The tools keyboard adds Agent control keys, Skills, and Snippets, and you can attach a photo or a file up to 64 MiB. [Voice Input guide](https://docs.heeler.bybee.dev/voice-input) - **Reach from anywhere**: Tailscale, ZeroTier, EasyTier, and tailcat are built into the app, so the phone needs no VPN app. A Jump Host covers machines you cannot route to, and a Host can have several routes. [Overlay networks](https://docs.heeler.bybee.dev/overlay-networks) · [Jump Host](https://docs.heeler.bybee.dev/vps-jump-host-setup) · [Routes](https://docs.heeler.bybee.dev/host-routes) - **Also**: QR pairing, Worktrees, a Changes view of staged and unstaged files, 30 themes, and iPad with Magic Keyboard shortcuts, multiwindow, and drag and drop. ## Installation Install Heeler from the [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/id6797263135) or [TestFlight](https://testflight.apple.com/join/aXSxRn4r). The machine needs SSH turned on and one of these backends: | Backend | Runs on | Guide | | --- | --- | --- | | [Herdr TUI](https://herdr.dev/docs/install/) | macOS, Linux | [Pair by scanning](https://docs.heeler.bybee.dev/pairing) | | Herdr TUI 0.9.3 or newer | Native Windows | [Windows setup](https://docs.heeler.bybee.dev/windows-setup) | | Herdr desktop app or herdr-core | macOS, Linux, native Windows | [Connect herdr-core](https://docs.heeler.bybee.dev/herdr-core) | | tmux 3.3 or newer | macOS, Linux | [Connect tmux](https://docs.heeler.bybee.dev/tmux) | | Rex (experimental, Heeler after 0.1.20) | macOS, Linux | [Connect Rex](https://docs.heeler.bybee.dev/rex) | ## Adding a machine Turn on the machine's OpenSSH server first (macOS: **System Settings > General > Sharing > Remote Login**). **Scan a Pairing Code.** On a macOS or Linux machine running Herdr TUI (herdr 0.7.5 or newer, Node 20 or newer), run: ```bash herdr plugin install ZingerLittleBee/Heeler --ref plugin --yes herdr plugin action invoke heeler.pair ``` Scan the code it shows and the machine is added as a Host, with its addresses, host key fingerprint, and SSH key in place. On a machine without herdr, such as one that runs only herdr-core or tmux, `npx -y heeler-pair@latest` shows the same code (Node 20 or newer, Heeler after 0.1.20). [Pairing guide](https://docs.heeler.bybee.dev/pairing) **Or enter the address.** This works for every backend. In **Hosts**, tap **+**, enter the address and your SSH user, and Heeler lists what the machine runs: Herdr TUI, herdr-core, each tmux server, and Rex. One Host can carry several of them. [Connect herdr-core](https://docs.heeler.bybee.dev/herdr-core) · [Connect tmux](https://docs.heeler.bybee.dev/tmux) · [Connect Rex](https://docs.heeler.bybee.dev/rex) · [Windows setup](https://docs.heeler.bybee.dev/windows-setup) **Away from home.** Reach the machine over a built-in [overlay network](https://docs.heeler.bybee.dev/overlay-networks) ([Tailscale](https://docs.heeler.bybee.dev/tailscale), [ZeroTier](https://docs.heeler.bybee.dev/zerotier), [EasyTier](https://docs.heeler.bybee.dev/easytier), [tailcat](https://docs.heeler.bybee.dev/tailcat)), a [Jump Host](https://docs.heeler.bybee.dev/vps-jump-host-setup), or [Cloudflare Tunnel](https://docs.heeler.bybee.dev/cloudflare-tunnel), and give the Host [several routes](https://docs.heeler.bybee.dev/host-routes) so it works at home and away. ## How it connects Heeler needs only SSH access and a running backend: no server changes, and no extra packages to connect. - **Herdr TUI**: herdr's JSON API over stream-local forwarding to `herdr.sock`, with terminals on an SSH PTY. OpenSSH allows the forwarding by default, though [SELinux on Fedora or RHEL](https://docs.heeler.bybee.dev/selinux) can deny it. - **herdr-core**: one framed link to the core's socket. - **tmux**: control mode, attached per Pane alongside your desktop clients, with Claude Code hooks reporting Agent status. - **Rex** (experimental): one WebSocket link to the socket of a Rex server that is already running, and one more channel for each open terminal. Heeler never starts Rex, and Rex has no notifications, Live Activities, or Usage. On macOS and Linux Hosts, notifications, Live Activities, and Usage come from the [Heeler plugin](plugin/README.md) on Herdr TUI and from the optional Host Helper on herdr-core and tmux. [Update the plugin and Host Helper](https://docs.heeler.bybee.dev/updates) Private keys are generated on the device and stay in the Keychain. A Host's key is pinned by its Pairing Code or confirmed by fingerprint on first connect. The decisions behind the transport are recorded in [`docs/adr/`](docs/adr). ## Opening an Agent from another app ```text heeler://agent?host=my-mac&session=work&pane=w1%3Ap1 ``` `host` is a saved Host's address or name (case is ignored), `session` is the herdr session (leave it out for the default), and `pane` is the pane id (leave it out to open the Console). Percent-encode each value, with `%20` for a space rather than `+`. A link that matches no saved Host, or more than one, opens the Console. ## Contributing Heeler is SwiftUI on iOS 18+, with SSH from the repository-local `Packages/HeelerSSH` (libssh2 and OpenSSL) and terminal rendering from [libghostty-spm](https://github.com/lakr233/libghostty-spm). Issues and PRs are welcome: [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) covers layout, build, test, and conventions. ## Status Released on the [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/id6797263135). It is not yet available in every country or region; where it is missing, the [TestFlight](https://testflight.apple.com/join/aXSxRn4r) build stays available. Built for personal use first and shaped by daily driving, so expect rough edges and fast iteration. Not affiliated with the herdr project.
detail.readme_zh:
# Heeler **在 iPhone 和 iPad 上掌控你自己机器上运行的编程 Agent。** 支持 [Herdr TUI](https://herdr.dev)、Herdr 桌面端（herdr-core）和 tmux，对 Rex 的支持为实验性。 [![GitHub stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/ZingerLittleBee/Heeler?style=flat-square&color=E8B923&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/ZingerLittleBee/Heeler/stargazers) [![CI](https://img.shields.io/github/actions/workflow/status/ZingerLittleBee/Heeler/ci.yml?branch=main&label=CI&style=flat-square)](https://github.com/ZingerLittleBee/Heeler/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![License: Apache 2.0](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-Apache_2.0-6F42C1?style=flat-square)](LICENSE) [![Swift](https://img.shields.io/badge/Swift-6-F05138?logo=swift&logoColor=white&style=flat-square)](https://www.swift.org) [![iOS](https://img.shields.io/badge/iOS-18%2B-000000?logo=apple&logoColor=white&style=flat-square)](https://developer.apple.com/ios/) [![App Store](https://img.shields.io/badge/App_Store-available-0D96F6?logo=apple&logoColor=white&style=flat-square)](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/id6797263135) [English](./README.md) | 简体中文 | [繁體中文](./README-zh-TW.md) | [日本語](./README-ja.md)
--- Heeler 是 iPhone 和 iPad 上独立、开源的 Agent 控制台，也是一款 **herdr 移动客户端**，用于操作 Claude Code、Codex 和其他编程 Agent。Agent 继续在你自己的机器上通过 Herdr TUI、Herdr 桌面端（herdr-core）或 tmux 运行，Heeler 通过 SSH 直连，代码不经过我们的服务器。一眼看出哪个 Agent 在等你，用原生 Chat 或真实终端回复，Agent 进入 Blocked 或 Done 时收到加密通知。 **[官网](https://heeler.bybee.dev)** · **[文档](https://docs.heeler.bybee.dev/zh)** · [隐私](PRIVACY.md) · [更新日志](CHANGELOG.md) ## 截图 | Agent Console | Chat | 实时终端 | | --- | --- | --- | | | | | | 实时活动 | Usage | 小组件 | | --- | --- | --- | | | | |
更多截图 | Keyboard | Changes | Terminals | | --- | --- | --- | | | | | | Skills | Hosts | 锁屏小组件 | | --- | --- | --- | | | | |
[查看 iPad 截图](docs/ipad-screenshots.md) ## 功能 - **Console**：所有机器上的 Agent 汇成一个实时列表，Blocked 排最前，可按 Host 过滤。 - **Chat**：以原生消息阅读 Agent 的对话，用按钮回答 Blocked 的 Agent。支持 Claude Code、Codex、Pi、Oh My Pi、Grok Build、OpenCode 和 Antigravity CLI。[Chat 教程](https://docs.heeler.bybee.dev/zh/chat) - **实时终端**：libghostty 渲染的 Agent 真实终端，支持原生历史回看和选择；也可以在 Agent 的目录打开普通 shell。 - **通知与实时活动**：Agent 进入 Blocked 或 Done 时收到端到端加密的推送，锁屏和灵动岛上实时显示 Agent。中继读不到内容。[隐私说明](PRIVACY.md) - **Usage**：Claude Code 与 Codex 的 Usage Limits 及重置时间，最多 30 天的 Token Usage 和估算 API 费用，以及主屏和锁屏小组件。[Usage 教程](https://docs.heeler.bybee.dev/zh/usage) - **Composer**：用完整的 iOS 键盘或语音起草，一次 Send 投递。工具键盘提供 Agent 控制键、Skills 和 Snippets，还可以附上照片或最大 64 MiB 的文件。[Voice Input 教程](https://docs.heeler.bybee.dev/zh/voice-input) - **随处可连**：内置 Tailscale、ZeroTier、EasyTier 和 tailcat，手机无需安装 VPN 应用。不可直连的机器可以走跳板机，一台 Host 可以有多条路由。[Overlay Network](https://docs.heeler.bybee.dev/zh/overlay-networks) · [跳板机](https://docs.heeler.bybee.dev/zh/vps-jump-host-setup) · [多条路由](https://docs.heeler.bybee.dev/zh/host-routes) - **其他**：扫码配对、Worktrees、查看已暂存和未暂存文件的 Changes、30 个主题，以及支持 Magic Keyboard 快捷键、多窗口和拖放的 iPad 版。 ## 安装 从 [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/id6797263135) 或 [TestFlight](https://testflight.apple.com/join/aXSxRn4r) 安装 Heeler。机器上需要开启 SSH，并运行下面任意一种后端： | 后端 | 运行平台 | 教程 | | --- | --- | --- | | [Herdr TUI](https://herdr.dev/docs/install/) | macOS、Linux | [扫码配对](https://docs.heeler.bybee.dev/zh/pairing) | | Herdr TUI 0.9.3 及以上 | Windows 原生环境 | [Windows 配置](https://docs.heeler.bybee.dev/zh/windows-setup) | | Herdr 桌面端或 herdr-core | macOS、Linux、Windows 原生环境 | [连接 herdr-core](https://docs.heeler.bybee.dev/zh/herdr-core) | | tmux 3.3 及以上 | macOS、Linux | [连接 tmux](https://docs.heeler.bybee.dev/zh/tmux) | | Rex（实验性，需要 0.1.20 之后的 Heeler） | macOS、Linux | [连接 Rex](https://docs.heeler.bybee.dev/zh/rex) | ## 添加机器 先开启机器上的 OpenSSH 服务器（macOS 上是 **系统设置 > 通用 > 共享 > 远程登录**）。 **扫码配对。** 在运行 Herdr TUI 的 macOS 或 Linux 机器上（herdr 0.7.5 及以上、Node 20 及以上）执行： ```bash herdr plugin install ZingerLittleBee/Heeler --ref plugin --yes herdr plugin action invoke heeler.pair ``` 用应用扫描弹出的 Pairing Code，机器即被添加为 Host，地址、host key 指纹和 SSH 密钥一并就绪。机器上没有 herdr、只运行 herdr-core 或 tmux 时，执行 `npx -y heeler-pair@latest` 可以显示同样的 Pairing Code（需要 Node 20 及以上，以及 0.1.20 之后的 Heeler）。[扫码配对教程](https://docs.heeler.bybee.dev/zh/pairing) **或者输入地址。** 适用于所有后端。在 **Hosts** 中轻点 **+**，输入地址和 SSH 用户，Heeler 会列出这台机器上运行的 Herdr TUI、herdr-core、每个 tmux 服务器和 Rex。一个 Host 可以同时带其中的多个。[连接 herdr-core](https://docs.heeler.bybee.dev/zh/herdr-core) · [连接 tmux](https://docs.heeler.bybee.dev/zh/tmux) · [连接 Rex](https://docs.heeler.bybee.dev/zh/rex) · [Windows 配置](https://docs.heeler.bybee.dev/zh/windows-setup) **不在同一网络时。** 通过内置的 [Overlay Network](https://docs.heeler.bybee.dev/zh/overlay-networks)（[Tailscale](https://docs.heeler.bybee.dev/zh/tailscale)、[ZeroTier](https://docs.heeler.bybee.dev/zh/zerotier)、[EasyTier](https://docs.heeler.bybee.dev/zh/easytier)、[tailcat](https://docs.heeler.bybee.dev/zh/tailcat)）、[跳板机](https://docs.heeler.bybee.dev/zh/vps-jump-host-setup)或 [Cloudflare Tunnel](https://docs.heeler.bybee.dev/zh/cloudflare-tunnel) 连接，并给 Host 配置[多条路由](https://docs.heeler.bybee.dev/zh/host-routes)，在家和在外都能连上。 ## 连接原理 Heeler 只需要 SSH 访问和一个运行中的后端：不改服务器，连接本身也不需要额外安装软件包。 - **Herdr TUI**：经 stream-local 转发直连 `herdr.sock`，使用 herdr 的 JSON API，终端运行在 SSH PTY 上。OpenSSH 默认允许这种转发，但 [Fedora 或 RHEL 上的 SELinux](https://docs.heeler.bybee.dev/zh/selinux) 可能会拦截。 - **herdr-core**：与 core 的套接字之间只有一条分帧链路。 - **tmux**：通过控制模式按 Pane 接入，与桌面客户端并存，Agent 状态由 Claude Code 钩子上报。 - **Rex**（实验性）：与已在运行的 Rex 服务器的套接字之间有一条 WebSocket 链路，每个打开的终端另用一条通道。Heeler 绝不会启动 Rex，Rex 上也没有通知、实时活动和 Usage。 在 macOS 和 Linux Host 上，通知、实时活动和 Usage 由 [Heeler 插件](plugin/README.md)（Herdr TUI）或可选的 Host Helper（herdr-core、tmux）提供。[更新插件与 Host Helper](https://docs.heeler.bybee.dev/zh/updates) 私钥在设备上生成，不离开 Keychain。Host 的密钥由 Pairing Code 固定，或在首次连接时由你核对指纹后确认。传输层的选型依据记录在 [`docs/adr/`](docs/adr)。 ## 从其他应用打开 Agent ```text heeler://agent?host=my-mac&session=work&pane=w1%3Ap1 ``` `host` 是已保存 Host 的地址或名称（忽略大小写），`session` 是 herdr 会话（省略即默认会话），`pane` 是窗格 ID（省略则打开 Console）。每个值都要做百分号编码，空格写成 `%20` 而不是 `+`。匹配不到已保存的 Host，或匹配到多个时，链接会打开 Console。 ## 参与贡献 Heeler 使用 SwiftUI，面向 iOS 18+，SSH 由仓库内的 `Packages/HeelerSSH`（libssh2 和 OpenSSL）提供，终端渲染使用 [libghostty-spm](https://github.com/lakr233/libghostty-spm)。欢迎 Issue 和 PR，仓库结构、构建、测试和约定见 [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md)。 ## 状态 已在 [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/id6797263135) 上发布；部分国家和地区尚未上架，可以继续使用 [TestFlight](https://testflight.apple.com/join/aXSxRn4r)。以个人日常使用打磨为先，仍有粗糙之处，迭代较快。与 herdr 项目无隶属关系。
